fields.reason: The paper explicitly compares a generator without document access (no retrieval) against a configuration that looks up supporting documents (retrieval-augmented) to evaluate hallucination rates.

selector.exact: The first condition is the generator without any document access. In this setup, the model relies on its parametric knowledge alone and never sees an external source. The second condition is the configuration that looks up supporting documents.
